# RunFps

> Free PC gaming performance calculator and bottleneck analyzer. Check estimated FPS for any GPU, CPU, and game combination. All FPS figures are calculated estimates, not measured benchmarks.

## Tools

- [FPS Calculator](https://runfps.com/en/calculator): pick a GPU, CPU, RAM, game, resolution, and quality preset to get instant FPS estimates.
- [Settings Optimizer](https://runfps.com/en/optimizer): enter a target FPS and get the exact settings to change, ordered by impact.
- [Bottleneck Calculator](https://runfps.com/en/bottleneck): find out whether the CPU or GPU limits performance for a specific game.
- [GPU Benchmarks](https://runfps.com/en/benchmarks/gpu): 95 GPUs ranked by gaming performance score with specs and per-GPU FPS tables.
- [CPU Benchmarks](https://runfps.com/en/benchmarks/cpu): 104 CPUs ranked by gaming performance score with specs and per-CPU FPS tables.
- [Games Library](https://runfps.com/en/games): 329 games with FPS estimates across 5 hardware tiers, system requirements, and optimization tips.
- [Compare](https://runfps.com/en/compare): put two GPUs or two CPUs head-to-head across popular games.

## Guides

## About

- [How We Calculate](https://runfps.com/en/methodology): GPU/CPU scores, per-game performance curves, RAM, resolution, and preset modeling.
- [FAQ](https://runfps.com/en/faq): common questions about estimates and features.

Available in English, Deutsch, Français, Español, and Português (Brasil) under /en/, /de/, /fr/, /es/, and /pt/.
